name: Clash Verge
author: jackzasian
description: Clash Verge proxy status and node switching in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Shows the active outbound node and mode from Clash Verge's local API, and switches nodes or toggles global/rule mode from the bar.

schema.label: Selector group name
schema.description: The proxy group in your Clash config that picks the outbound node (Clash Verge's default profile calls this GLOBAL; many custom configs, including this default, name their main selector something else). Falls back to GLOBAL automatically if this name isn't found.
